text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see a dejected prisoner of the Raiders.
source_text: You see a dejected prisoner of the Raiders.

text: Hey, you! Get me out of here!
source_text: Hey, you! Get me out of here!

text: Be quiet, you're gonna alert the guards!
source_text: Be quiet, you're gonna alert the guards!

text: Shh! Who are you?
source_text: Shh! Who are you?

text: Goop
source_text: Goop

text: I don't care. Get me out of here please!
source_text: I don't care. Get me out of here please!

text: My name is Jack. I'm from Junktown. These monsters killed the rest of my caravan and put me here.
source_text: My name is Jack. I'm from Junktown. These monsters killed the rest of my caravan and put me here.

text: Ok. I'll see what I can do.
source_text: Ok. I'll see what I can do.

text: What a bummer. Enjoy your stay.
source_text: What a bummer. Enjoy your stay.

text: Please, just help me out.
source_text: Please, just help me out.

text: Ow! My leg. It's hurt. I think it might be broken. Please help me!
source_text: Ow! My leg. It's hurt. I think it might be broken. Please help me!

text: 你看到一个被歹徒关起来的囚犯，很沮丧的样子。
source_text: 你看到一个被歹徒关起来的囚犯，很沮丧的样子。

text: 嘿，你！把我从这里弄出去！
source_text: 嘿，你！把我从这里弄出去！

text: 小心点，你要把守卫惊动哇！！
source_text: 小心点，你要把守卫惊动哇！！

text: 嘘，你是谁？
source_text: 嘘，你是谁？

text: 咕。
source_text: 咕。

text: 我不喜欢这样，请把我从这里弄出去！
source_text: 我不喜欢这样，请把我从这里弄出去！

text: 我叫杰克。我来自迦克镇。这些怪物杀了我商队的其他人并把我关在这里。
source_text: 我叫杰克。我来自迦克镇。这些怪物杀了我商队的其他人并把我关在这里。

text: 好的，我看看我能做些什么。
source_text: 好的，我看看我能做些什么。

text: 真是个废物，继续待在这吧。
source_text: 真是个废物，继续待在这吧。

text: 拜托！请帮我离开。
source_text: 拜托！请帮我离开。

text: 啊！我的腿受伤了，我想它断了，请帮帮我！
source_text: 啊！我的腿受伤了，我想它断了，请帮帮我！
